title: Executable but Unfaithful: Mock Object, Stub, and Assertion Generation by LLMs and Coding Agents
title_zh: 可执行却不可信：大型语言模型与编码智能体在模拟对象、模拟桩和断言生成方面的表现

paragraphs.en: Mocking is a foundational practice in unit testing, enabling developers to isolate the code under test by replacing real dependencies with simulated alternatives. Automating the generation of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions has been a long-standing research goal. However, capture-and-replay approaches rely on recording the runtime behavior of actual dependencies. Evolutionary approaches such as StubCoder overcome this requirement but constrain generation to predefined symbol pools. Large language models (LLMs) and coding agents offer an alternative by generating mocking artifacts from source code without requiring recorded dependency executions or fixed symbol pools. Yet, no systematic study has evaluated their capabilities across all three artifact types.

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we construct MockBench, a benchmark comprising 165 mock artifact generation tasks from real-world Java and Python projects, with validated reference mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions. We evaluate six LLMs and three coding agents in terms of executability, behavior fidelity, and interaction-fault detection capability, complemented by comparisons with existing tools and sensitivity analysis. Experimental results show that LLMs and coding agents indeed have been the state-of-the-art techniques in mock-based testing. More specifically, compared with LLMs, coding agents substantially improve executability, while these gains do not consistently translate into higher behavior fidelity or better interaction-fault detection. Furthermore, we analyze 660 failures from LLMs and coding agents, and identify ten error types across the three artifact categories, revealing behavioral deviations that passing tests can conceal. Our findings highlight the challenges of mock artifact generation and provide practical guidance for both developers and researchers.

paragraphs.en: Unit testing is a cornerstone of modern software quality assurance. In practice, a software component (e.g., a Java class or method) commonly depends on other components, such as databases, payment gateways, file systems, or network services, thereby fulfilling its functionality ( Mostafa and Wang, 2014 ; Saff and Ernst, 2004 ) . Testing such a component in isolation is challenging because its correctness depends on the correctness and availability of these dependencies. Mocking addresses this challenge by replacing real dependencies with simulated substitutes, known as test doubles ( Li and Fazzini, 2025 ; Fazzini et al., 2022 ) , that mimic the behavior of actual dependencies for testing purposes only. Normally, A well-formed mock-based test involves three interdependent artifacts: (1) Mock objects answer the question of what to mock, i.e., which dependencies should be replaced to achieve proper test isolation. (2) Stubs answer the question of how the mock should behave. Specifically, they specify the return values, side effects, and exception scenarios that the mock should produce when its methods are called. (3) Mock assertions check whether the dependencies were used correctly, including their argument values, invocation counts, call order, etc. Listing 1 illustrates a JUnit ( JUnit Team, 2026 ) test case with all three mocking artifacts implemented with Mockito framework ( Mockito Team, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: The test exercises the focal method, charge() , whose faulty and correct implementations are shown in Lines 15-21 and Lines 27–33, respectively, in a scenario where the payment can be authorized a charge up to three times, retrying only on a TimeoutException . To isolate the focal method from the actual dependency, the test creates a mock object for BankClient , namely bank (Line 4), and passes it to PaymentService as an initialization parameter (Line 10). The stub on Lines 5–7 specifies consecutive reactions on this mock object: the first call to authorize() throws a TimeoutException , simulating a transient network fault; the second returns true , indicating a successful authorization, thereby testing the loop logic of the focal method with the follow-up mock assertions. As such, the focal method, charge() , can be tested in isolation with mock objects and stubs. Continuing, the oracle assertion on Line 12 ( assertTrue(ok) ) validates the final output, while the mock assertion on Line 13 verifies that authorize() was invoked exactly twice on the same mock object with the specified card id and amount. Obviously, the correct focal method immediately returns true at the second invocation of authorize() , whereas the faulty one continues the loop and makes an unnecessary third call to authorize() . Although they both pass the oracle assertion, the mock assertion reveals the fault of the latter.

paragraphs.en: As can be seen, systematic mocking, as in the example above, is effective for test isolation and fine-grained program verification. However, it is also noted that crafting all three kinds of artifacts by hand is labor-intensive and error-prone because they are tightly coupled to the specific implementations of the focal methods and their test cases, making them even more fragile to consistent code evolution. As such, mocking artifact automation has consequently been a long-standing research goal. Previous studies fall into three categories: (1) capture-and-replay approaches, (2) evolutionary algorithms, and (3) LLM-based testing tools. (1) Capture-and-replay approaches ( Saff and Ernst, 2004 ; Saff et al., 2005 ) generate mock artifacts by first executing the actual dependency to record its runtime interactions, then replacing the dependency with a mock object and replaying the recorded behavior. While straightforward, these approaches have a fundamental constraint: they require the actual dependency to be runnable. Spadini et al. ( Spadini et al., 2017 ) showed that 83% of mock-using test cases are introduced precisely when the actual dependencies are hard to set up, flaky, or unavailable, rendering capture-and-replay inapplicable in the majority of realistic mocking scenarios. (2) Evolutionary algorithms (e.g., StubCoder ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) ) overcame the runnability requirement by optimizing the permutations and combinations among symbols to directly produce executable mocking artifacts. Nonetheless, their symbol pools are confined to literals within the focal method and associated test file, for the sake of improving symbol reusability and avoiding search space explosion. Consequently, it cannot synthesize return values or exception types that do not already appear in this narrow scope. (3) We have also noted that some LLM-based unit test generation studies passingly produce test stubs to ensure the tests can execute, yet the quality of these stubs was not evaluated ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Nan et al., 2025 ) . We agree that LLMs or even coding agents are promising workarounds for mock-based testing, as they reason over source code semantics rather than depending on runnable dependencies or local symbol pools. Moreover, coding agents can further leverage project-wide context, build systems, and execution feedback to iteratively refine their outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 由此可见，如上文示例所示的系统性模拟方法，对于测试隔离和细粒度程序验证是有效的。然而，我们也注意到，手动创建全部三种类型的模拟制品既费力又容易出错，因为它们与目标方法的特定实现及其测试用例紧密耦合，因此在对代码持续演进的变化中显得更加脆弱。正因如此，模拟制品的自动化长期以来一直是研究的重要目标。以往的研究可分为三类：（1）捕获-重播方法；（2）进化算法；以及（3）基于大语言模型（LLM）的测试工具。（1）捕获-重播方法（Saff 和 Ernst，2004；Saff 等，2005）通过首先执行实际的依赖项以记录其运行时交互，然后用模拟对象替换该依赖项并重播记录的行为来生成模拟制品。尽管这种方法看似直接，但它存在一个根本性限制：要求实际依赖项必须可运行。Spadini 等（Spadini 等，2017）的研究表明，83% 的使用模拟的测试用例恰恰是在实际依赖项难以设置、运行不稳定或不可用时引入的，这使得捕获-重播方法在大多数真实的模拟场景中都无法适用。（2）进化算法（例如 StubCoder（Zhu 等，2023））通过优化符号之间的排列组合，直接生成可执行的模拟制品，从而克服了可运行性的要求。然而，为了提高符号的复用性并避免搜索空间爆炸，这些方法的符号池仅限于目标方法及其相关测试文件中的字面量。因此，它们无法合成在此有限范围内尚未出现的返回值或异常类型。（3）我们还注意到，一些基于 LLM 的单元测试生成研究在确保测试能够执行时，会附带生成测试占位符，但这些占位符的质量并未得到评估（Yang 等，2026；Pan 等，2025；Nan 等，2025）。我们认同，LLM 甚至编码智能体为基于模拟的测试提供了有前景的替代方案，因为它们能够基于源代码的语义进行推理，而无需依赖可运行的依赖项或局部符号池。此外，编码智能体还可以进一步利用整个项目的上下文、构建系统和执行反馈，迭代优化其输出结果。

paragraphs.en: Nonetheless, their generative quality on the end-to-end pipeline of mock objects, stubs, and assertions is unexplored in the literature.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在模拟对象、存根和断言构成的端到端流程中，其生成能力在现有文献中尚未得到探讨。

paragraphs.en: Empirical Study: To fill this gap, we first construct MockBench , a benchmark comprising 165 mock artifact generation tasks from real-world Java and Python projects, with validated reference mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions. Based on MockBench , we conduct a systematic study to evaluate the quality of mock artifacts generated by six LLMs and three coding agents in an end-to-end manner, where LLMs include GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Qwen3.7-Max of the commercial category, DeepSeek-v4-pro of the general category, alongside Qwen3-Coder-480B/30B of the code category. For coding agents, we experiment with mini-SWE-agent , OpenCode , and Claude Code . The evaluation includes executability, behavior fidelity, fault detection ability, baseline comparison, and sensitivity analysis. Moreover, we conduct a manual analysis of 660 failures made by typical LLMs and coding agents, finalizing a systematic taxonomy for future reference.

paragraphs.en: Mocking is a core practice for isolating dependencies in unit tests ( Mostafa and Wang, 2014 ) . Spadini et al. ( Spadini et al., 2017 ) conducted the first large-scale empirical study on when developers choose to mock. Ahmed et al. ( Ahmed et al., 2026 ) complemented this perspective by analyzing 25,302 mocking-related questions on StackOverflow, identifying that mock configuration and framework-specific API usage remain persistent developer pain points. More recently, Hora et al. ( Hora and Robbes, 2026 ) analyzed over 1.2 million real-world commits on GitHub and found that coding agents add mocks more frequently than human developers, and this trend is growing. Qin ( Qin, 2025 ) further revealed a divergence in mock decisions between LLMs and developers. Going beyond empirical observation, Zhu et al. ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) proposed MockSniffer, an ML-based approach to automatically recommend which dependencies to mock, but it only outputs binary decisions rather than generating actual mock code. With the rise of LLMs for test generation, a few works have touched upon mocking. MockMill ( Lee et al., 2026 ) extracts mocking information from existing developer tests to guide LLMs for new test generation. Notably, MocklessTester ( Xu et al., 2026 ) takes the opposite direction by deliberately avoiding mocks, which implicitly acknowledges that handling dependencies is a known pain point for LLM-driven test generation.

paragraphs.en: Beyond deciding what to mock and generating mock objects, an equally important challenge is generating stub behavior, including the return values, side effects, and exception handling that make mocked dependencies behave realistically in tests. Early automated stub generation efforts, from capture-and-replay that records actual dependency behavior ( Saff and Ernst, 2004 ; Saff et al., 2005 ) , to EvoSuite’s built-in stubs that target environment-dependent classes with handcrafted rules ( Arcuri et al., 2014 ) , share a common limitation: they either require the actual dependency to be available and executable, or rely on domain-specific heuristics that cannot generalize to arbitrary dependencies. StubCoder ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) overcame these constraints by using an evolutionary algorithm guided by runtime test behavior to synthesize stub code without needing the actual dependency, and in a domain-agnostic manner. Some automatic testing approaches also involve stub generation, such as AUTS ( Nguyen Tung et al., 2024 ) , Bach et al. ( Bach et al., 2026 ) , and IntUT ( Nan et al., 2025 ) , which aim to make generated tests executable; however, stub quality was not isolated as an evaluation target. Besides, Cheddadi et al. ( Cheddadi et al., 2026 ) did not propose any approach; instead, they demonstrated the use of Google Test/Google Mock to write stubs for embedded verification.
paragraphs.zh: 除了决定要模拟什么以及生成模拟对象之外，另一个同等重要的挑战是生成模拟桩行为，包括返回值、副作用和异常处理机制，这些机制能使被模拟的依赖项在测试中表现得更加真实。早期的自动化模拟桩生成方法，从记录实际依赖行为的“捕获与重演”方法（Saff 和 Ernst，2004；Saff 等，2005），到 EvoSuite 内置的、针对环境相关类并采用人工制定规则的模拟桩（Arcuri 等，2014），都存在一个共同的局限性：它们要么要求实际的依赖项可用且可执行，要么依赖特定领域的启发式方法，而这些方法无法推广到任意的依赖项。StubCoder（Zhu 等，2023）通过采用由运行时测试行为引导的进化算法，无需实际依赖项即可合成模拟桩代码，从而克服了这些限制，并且其方法不依赖于特定领域。一些自动化测试方法也涉及模拟桩生成，例如 AUTS（Nguyen Tung 等，2024）、Bach 等（Bach 等，2026）以及 IntUT（Nan 等，2025），这些方法旨在使生成的测试可执行；然而，模拟桩的质量并未被单独作为评估目标。此外，Cheddadi 等（Cheddadi 等，2026）并未提出任何具体方法，而是展示了如何使用 Google Test/Google Mock 为嵌入式验证编写模拟桩。

paragraphs.en: Mock assertions check whether mocked methods were invoked with expected behaviors , which are the third essential component of mock-based testing. Zhu et al. ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) conducted the first empirical study on mock assertions, characterizing their adoption, patterns, and usage in open-source projects. Their findings provide valuable insights into how developers write mock assertions, but the study is purely descriptive without addressing automated generation. Tiwari et al. ( Tiwari et al., 2024 ) proposed RICK, which monitors production execution data to generate mock-based artifacts (mock objects, stubs, and assertions) derived from production interactions to detect regression faults. However, it fundamentally depends on production deployment to collect execution traces and the Spoon metaprogramming framework for rule-based code generation, making it inapplicable during the development phase that is the focus of this study.

paragraphs.en: In summary, prior work has made extensive contributions in mock-based testing, but most of them either focus solely on a single phase or have not yet touched upon LLMs and coding agents for a systematic evaluation. Compared to traditional methods, LLMs and agents offer greater flexibility in generation and hold significant potential for further enhancing the applicability of automated mock testing. This paper, therefore, conducts a systematic study to address this gap.

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Listing 1, the unit tests considered in MockBench are organized according to the Arrange–Act–Assert (AAA) pattern ( Yu et al., 2019 ) . The Arrange phase creates and configures mock objects, including their stub calls; the Act phase invokes the focal method, i.e., Method Under Test (MUT); and the Assert phase checks the test outcome through oracle assertions and, when applicable, mock assertions that verify expected interactions with mocks.

paragraphs.en: To shrink the experimental cost, we process each complete test suite as one generation unit. Developer-written test suites T G T^{G} are used as ground truth. paragraphs.en: This section introduces MockBench , a bilingual benchmark for evaluating mock artifact generation across real-world Java and Python projects. It provides ground-truth mock objects, stubs, and assertions for both ecosystems. We describe the benchmark construction and data statistics below.

paragraphs.en: Java Portion For the Java portion, we build upon StubCoder ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) , which provides 59 real-world test cases across 13 projects with genuine mock configurations, production code, and compilation dependencies. However, not all external dependencies are mocked, and the existing mock assertions do not always fully specify the expected dependency interactions. Therefore, further refinement is needed for our evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, following a pervasive mocking practice ( Spadini et al., 2019 ; Arcuri et al., 2017 ) , we first select MUT-dependent objects that come from third-party libraries or outside the class of the MUT for mocking. Next, for each selected dependency in the MUT, we progressively add mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions if they are missing in the original test. Our modification does not change the production code, focal calls, test inputs, or fixtures. We also augmented the suites with oracle assertions to verify the observable outcomes of stubbed behaviors. In total, 53 of the 59 Java test suites received additional checks: oracle assertions increased from 117 to 201, while mock assertions rose from 61 to 126. Consequently, all 59 suites now enforce explicit interaction verifications, up from only 30 in the original baseline. We implement tests using JUnit ( JUnit Team, 2026 ) alongside Mockito ( Mockito Team, 2026 ) , managing dependencies through Maven ( Apache Software Foundation, 2026 ) or Gradle ( Gradle Inc., [n.d.] ) .
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们遵循一种普遍存在的模拟实践（Spadini 等人，2019；Arcuri 等人，2017），首先选择来自第三方库或位于被测试类（MUT）之外的、依赖于 MUT 的对象进行模拟。 接下来，对于 MUT 中的每个已选依赖项，如果原始测试中缺少模拟对象、占位程序和模拟断言，我们会逐步添加这些元素。 我们的修改并未改变生产代码、核心调用、测试输入或测试框架。 我们还为测试套件增加了预言机断言，以验证被占位行为的可观察结果。 总计，59 个 Java 测试套件中有 53 个获得了额外的检查：预言机断言从 117 个增加到 201 个，而模拟断言则从 61 个上升到 126 个。 因此，所有 59 个测试套件现在都强制执行了显式的交互验证，而原始基线中仅有 30 个具备此功能。 我们使用 JUnit（JUnit 团队，2026）和 Mockito（Mockito 团队，2026）实现测试，并通过 Maven（Apache Software Foundation，2026）或 Gradle（Gradle Inc.，[n.d.]）管理依赖项。

paragraphs.en: Python Portion Existing Python testing benchmarks focus on test generation and coverage assessment ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2024 ) , or provide reproducible real-world bugs for testing and debugging studies ( Widyasari et al., 2020 ) . These evaluation objectives differ from our focus on mocking artifact generation. We therefore construct a dedicated Python benchmark tailored to this task.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 Python 测试基准主要关注测试生成和覆盖率评估（Wang 等人，2025；Jain 等人，2024），或者为测试和调试研究提供可复现的真实世界错误（Widyasari 等人，2020）。 这些评估目标与我们专注于模拟产物生成的重点有所不同。 因此，我们构建了一个专门针对这项任务的 Python 基准。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we curate 106 MUTs from 12 open-source projects across 6 application domains with rich dependencies and high popularity (Table 1 ). Nonetheless, most MUTs in the wild are not equipped with sufficient test cases. Therefore, we manually construct a reference test suite for each Python MUT to capture multiple representative dependency-interaction scenarios. Each suite uses parameterized tests to instantiate these scenarios by varying method inputs and stubbed dependency responses while specifying the corresponding expected interactions, without modifying production code. Furthermore, each reference suite is required to achieve at least 90% line coverage of its MUT to ensure sufficient exercise of the focal logic. The Python portion uses pytest ( pytest-dev Team, 2026a ) as the testing framework and pytest-mock ( pytest-dev Team, 2026b ) for mock-object construction and interaction verification.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们从 6 个应用领域中 12 个开源项目里精选了 106 个 MUT，这些项目具有丰富的依赖关系和高知名度（表 1）。 然而，大多数实际存在的 MUT 并未配备足够的测试用例。 因此，我们为每个 Python MUT 手动构建了一个参考测试套件，以覆盖多种具有代表性的依赖交互场景。 每个套件都使用参数化测试来实例化这些场景：通过改变方法输入和模拟的依赖响应，同时指定相应的预期交互，而无需修改生产代码。 此外，每个参考套件必须至少达到其 MUT 90% 的行覆盖度，以确保对核心逻辑进行充分执行。 Python 部分使用 pytest（pytest-dev Team, 2026a）作为测试框架，并使用 pytest-mock（pytest-dev Team, 2026b）来构建模拟对象和验证交互。

paragraphs.en: Following the aforementioned design, seven developers participated in constructing MockBench , with one serving as the lead reviewer and the remaining six responsible for benchmark construction. Each developer independently processed the assigned subjects—refining reference tests for Java and constructing parameterized reference suites for Python according to the established guidelines. The lead reviewer then examined all completed items to verify dependency selection, scenario design, and mock-artifact completeness, resolving any disputed or borderline cases. Finally, all reviewed tests were validated via execution: Java tests had to compile and pass, whereas Python suites were required to pass all parameterized test cases and meet the predefined MUT line-coverage threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 按照上述设计，七名开发者参与了 MockBench 的构建工作，其中一人担任主要评审员，其余六人负责基准测试的构建。 每位开发者都独立处理分配给自己的主题——根据既定指南完善 Java 的参考测试，并构建 Python 的参数化参考套件。 随后，主要评审员检查了所有已完成的项目，以验证依赖项的选择、场景设计以及模拟工件的完整性，并解决了任何存在争议或处于边界情况的问题。 最后，所有经过评审的测试都通过执行进行了验证：Java 测试必须能够编译并通过，而 Python 套件则必须通过所有参数化测试用例，并达到预定义的 MUT 行覆盖阈值。

paragraphs.en: This study uses MockBench to evaluate LLMs and coding agents on mock artifact generation with the following five Research Questions (RQs):
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用 MockBench 来评估大型语言模型（LLM）和编码智能体在模拟产物生成方面的表现，并围绕以下五个研究问题（RQ）展开：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Executability): How do LLMs and coding agents perform in generating executable mock artifacts? Generating mock-object declarations, stub calls, and mock assertions together requires coordinating how dependencies are replaced, how they respond, and which interactions are checked. We first examine whether LLMs and coding agents can deliver T C T^{C} with auto-generated mocking artifacts that make the MUT pass all the tests.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（可执行性）：LLM 和编码智能体在生成可执行的模拟工件方面的表现如何？ 同时生成模拟对象声明、占位符调用和模拟断言需要协调依赖项的替换方式、其响应机制以及需要检查的交互。 我们首先考察 LLM 和编码智能体是否能够借助自动生成的模拟工件实现 T C T^{C}，从而让 MUT 通过所有测试。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Interaction-Fault Detection Capability): To what extent do T C T^{C} preserve the fault detection capability encoded by developer-written references T G T^{G} ? An executable T C T^{C} does not necessarily mean it preserves the T G T^{G} ’s sensitivity to incorrect interactions between dependencies and the MUT, namely interaction faults. paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Baseline Comparison): How do LLMs and coding agents perform relative to dedicated mock generation tools? Among existing mock-related techniques, StubCoder is the only comparable baseline: similar to LLMs and coding agents, it synthesizes stub behaviors from code and test context without executing real dependencies. Nevertheless, its native scope is limited to stub generation, whereas we tackle the holistic generation of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions.

paragraphs.en: RQ5 (Resource Sensitivity): How does the operational time budget influence the effectiveness and workflow of coding agents? paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Executability) As mentioned in Section 3.1 , for every masked test suite T ~ \widetilde{T} , we generate three mock artifacts holistically, including mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions, and reassemble them into T ~ \widetilde{T} , obtaining a candidate test suite T C T^{C} for evaluation. RQ1 measures executability through Compile pass rate (CPR), Suite pass rate (SPR), and Test case pass rate (TPR), where CPR is the fraction of T C T^{C} that compile successfully, SPR is the fraction of T C T^{C} in which all test cases pass, and TPR measures the proportion of passing test cases within T C T^{C} . Note that the Java portion of MockBench , inherited from StubCoder ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) , contains one test case per suite, so SPR and TPR coincide on Java. The two metrics diverge only on the Python benchmark, where a test suite contains multiple parameterised test cases.

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Behavior Fidelity) To examine the faithfulness of T C T^{C} towards T G T^{G} , we parse the AST of both tests to structurally extract their interaction records of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions. In general, each statement of mock object declaration can be recorded as a pair ⟨ 𝑐𝑟𝑒𝑎𝑡𝑜𝑟 , 𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑒𝑡 ⟩ \langle\mathit{creator},\mathit{target}\rangle , where 𝑐𝑟𝑒𝑎𝑡𝑜𝑟 \mathit{creator} is the invocation of the mock creation API, while 𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑒𝑡 \mathit{target} is the class being mocked. Besides, each statement of a stub call can be recorded as a five-field tuple ⟨ 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑣 , 𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ , 𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑠 , 𝑘𝑖𝑛𝑑 , 𝑣𝑎𝑙 ⟩ \langle\mathit{recv},\mathit{meth},\mathit{args},\mathit{kind},\mathit{val}\rangle , where 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑣 \mathit{recv} is the mock object instantiated from a 𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑒𝑡 \mathit{target} , 𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ \mathit{meth} is an instance method of 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑣 \mathit{recv} invoked by the MUT, 𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑠 \mathit{args} are the arguments passed to 𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ \mathit{meth} , 𝑘𝑖𝑛𝑑 \mathit{kind} is the stub response type (e.g., return value, thrown exception), and 𝑣𝑎𝑙 \mathit{val} is the corresponding output value. Finally, each mock assertion is analogously recorded as a four-tuple ⟨ 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑣 , 𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ , 𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑠 , 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑠𝑡𝑟 ⟩ \langle\mathit{recv},\mathit{meth},\mathit{args},\mathit{constr}\rangle , where 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑠𝑡𝑟 \mathit{constr} captures the verification constraint imposed on the expected interaction. Taking Listing 1 as an example, the mock-object declaration at Line 4 yields a mock record: 𝑐𝑟𝑒𝑎𝑡𝑜𝑟 \mathit{creator} = mock() and 𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑒𝑡 \mathit{target} = BankClient . The stub at Lines 5–7 specifies two consecutive responses to bank.authorize(anyString(), anyDouble()) : the first invocation throws a TimeoutException , and the second returns true . Taking the return response at Line 7 as an example, the five fields are 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑣 \mathit{recv} = bank , 𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ \mathit{meth} = authorize , 𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑠 \mathit{args} = (anyString(), anyDouble()) , 𝑘𝑖𝑛𝑑 \mathit{kind} = return , and 𝑣𝑎𝑙 \mathit{val} = true . The mock assertion at Line 15 yields a record with four fields: 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑣 \mathit{recv} = bank , 𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ \mathit{meth} = authorize , 𝑎𝑟𝑔𝑠 \mathit{args} = ("card-001", 150.0) , and 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑠𝑡𝑟 \mathit{constr} = times(2) . Since there are different APIs with equivalent functionalities (e.g., thenReturn and doReturn ), we normalize them to the same name in records, thereby facilitating a more accurate evaluation.

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Interaction-Fault Detection Capability) Following prior mutation-based evaluations ( Tiwari et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) , we compare the mutants detected by T C T^{C} and T G T^{G} . However, general-purpose mutation tools such as PIT ( Coles et al., 2016 ) and Cosmic Ray ( Sixty North AS, n.d. ) do not specifically target the collaborator interactions checked by mock assertions ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Our preliminary experiments also found that mutants produced by these tools were often caught by oracle assertions before reaching the interactions checked by mock assertions, making it difficult to distinguish the interaction-fault detection capabilities of T G T^{G} and T C T^{C} . Mock assertions check interactions between collaborators and the MUT in terms of whether calls occur, how often they occur, the arguments they receive, whether unintended calls occur, and their execution order ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Freeman et al., 2004 ) . Accordingly, we design five first-order mutation operators, each introducing a single fault into one of these interaction dimensions ( Jia and Harman, 2009 ) . (1) DuplicateCall : duplicates a call, e.g., authorize() → \to authorize(); authorize() ; (2) AlterArgument : modifies an argument, e.g., cache.get(key) → \to cache.get("MUTATED") ; (3) DropCall : removes a call, e.g., audit.record(id) → \to ∅ \varnothing ; (4) InsertForbiddenCall : inserts an absent call, e.g., ∅ \varnothing → \to dao.delete(id) ; and (5) AlterOrder : swaps two ordered calls, e.g., authorize(); settle() → \to settle(); authorize() .
paragraphs.zh: RQ3（交互故障检测能力）：基于先前的突变评估研究（Tiwari 等人，2024；Zhu 等人，2023），我们比较了 T C T^{C} 和 T G T^{G} 所检测到的突变体。 然而，通用突变工具（如 PIT（Coles 等人，2016）和 Cosmic Ray（Sixty North AS，未注明日期））并未专门针对模拟断言所检查的协作对象交互（Zhang 等人，2025）。 我们的初步实验还发现，这些工具生成的突变体通常在到达模拟断言所检查的交互之前就被预言机断言捕获，这使得难以区分 T G T^{G} 和 T C T^{C} 在交互故障检测能力上的差异。 模拟断言通过检查调用是否发生、发生频率、接收的参数、是否出现意外调用以及执行顺序等方面，来验证协作对象与 MUT 之间的交互（Zhu 等人，2025；Freeman 等人，2004）。 因此，我们设计了五种一阶突变算子，每种算子都会在这些交互维度中引入一个单一故障（Jia 和 Harman，2009）。 （1）DuplicateCall：重复调用，例如 authorize() → \to authorize(); authorize()；（2）AlterArgument：修改参数，例如 cache.get(key) → \to cache.get("MUTATED")；（3）DropCall：删除调用，例如 audit.record(id) → \to ∅ \varnothing；（4）InsertForbiddenCall：插入未存在的调用，例如 ∅ \varnothing → \to dao.delete(id)；以及（5）AlterOrder：交换两个有序调用的顺序，例如 authorize(); settle() → \to settle(); authorize()。

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Baseline Comparison) StubCoder is a stub generation tool based on the evolutionary algorithm, but it applies only to Java. paragraphs.en: For agent-based generation, each benchmark evaluation runs within an isolated Docker container with a dedicated workspace allocated per generation task. To simulate scenarios where concrete dependency implementations are inaccessible, we deliberately strip the corresponding implementations from the workspace. paragraphs.en: Comparison among LLMs. As shown in Table 3 , the three commercial LLMs (i.e., GPT-5.5, Claude, and Qwen3.7-Max) lead in TPR across both Java and Python. These models benefit from strong general reasoning and long-context capabilities, allowing them to follow complex prompt instructions and handle mock setup constraints more reliably. When comparing general and code-specialized models, general LLMs hold a clear edge. Specifically, Qwen3.7-Max consistently outperforms both Qwen3-Coder variants across both languages. Compared to Qwen3-480B, Qwen3.7-Max achieves a TPR that is 21.2 pp higher on Java and 12.0 pp higher on Python. This gap suggests that synthesizing mock artifacts requires more than familiar code patterns; it demands deep reasoning about method execution paths and dependency behaviors, where massive general-purpose models excel. Within the same family, model scale remains a primary performance driver. Qwen3-480B substantially beats Qwen3-30B on both languages, lifting TPR by 12.7 pp on Java and 6.8 pp on Python. The larger parameter budget especially benefits Java, where strict static typing and verbose framework APIs require precise symbol resolution and syntax accuracy.

paragraphs.en: To dive deeper into a fine-grained evaluation of stub and mock assertion quality, we present Table 5 with assessment in terms of Method, Argument, Response, and Output for stubs, as well as Method, Argument, and Constraint for mock assertions. For stubs, the correctness of Output consistently achieves the lowest precision, recall, and F1-score among the four evaluation aspects. Across standalone LLMs and coding agents, average Output F1 trails Method, Response, and Argument F1 by 6.04–17.41 pp on Java and 14.24–19.74 pp on Python, making Output the weakest stub aspect in both languages. These results indicate that the major difficulty in stub generation lies in determining the concrete output of a stub. While methods and arguments can often be directly extracted from dependency calls in the MUT and response types can often be inferred from surrounding control structures (e.g., try-catch blocks or assignment statements), concrete outputs do not appear in the MUT. Instead, they must be tailored to the specific interaction logic intended by the test scenario, which requires models to understand how the returned state drives the execution path. Moreover, although coding agents can iteratively repair tests via runtime feedback, execution errors (e.g., generic NullPointerException or assertion failures) rarely convey the exact expected return values or exceptions, leaving Output synthesis a fundamental challenge across both standalone LLMs and coding agents.

paragraphs.en: For mock assertions, invocation methods consistently achieve higher F1-score than arguments and invocation-count constraints across both standalone LLMs and coding agents(Table 5 ). On average, Argument F1-score falls behind Method F1-score by 6.16–10.21 pp on Java and 8.64–10.60 pp on Python across LLMs and coding agents, while Constraint F1-score lags by 4.07–5.24 pp on Java and 6.10–11.19 pp on Python. These discrepancies indicate that identifying which method to verify is much easier than verifying how it is called. Specifically, identifying the invocation target mainly requires locating which collaborator method is called, whereas reproducing its arguments additionally requires tracing how values are computed and transformed inside the MUT. These arguments may be assembled from multiple variables, converted into new representations, or serialized before the collaborator is invoked. When models are uncertain about these intermediate values, they often resort to permissive matchers like any() , leading to low argument fidelity. Likewise, verifying the exact invocation count requires accurately tracking loops and conditional branches, which models frequently misjudge even when they correctly identify the target method.

paragraphs.en: Does feedback repair of coding agents improve mock quality? While coding agents leverage iterative test execution feedback to resolve runtime failures, Table 4 reveals that this feedback mechanism does not translate into higher mock fidelity over standalone LLMs. Specifically, standalone LLMs outperform coding agents by an average of 18.14 pp and 27.80 pp in F1 score for stubs and mock assertions on Python, while on Java, agents yield only a marginal 6.38 pp gain on stubs and show no advantage on mock assertions. A Zipkin task illustrates how repair can make a test pass without restoring the intended interaction constraint. The reference test requires exactly two invocations of getCassandraVersion() . Claude Code initially generated verify(node).getCassandraVersion() , which checks for one invocation and caused the test to fail. The agent then changed the assertion to atLeastOnce() rather than restoring the exact count. The repaired test passed, but the assertion could no longer detect calls beyond the required two. This case illustrates the distinction between executability and behavior fidelity. Compiler and test feedback help agents identify errors, but passing the available tests does not establish that generated mocks preserve all intended collaborator behaviors. Consequently, successful repair alone is insufficient to demonstrate improved behavior fidelity.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 8 , StubCoder and the LLM-based approaches exhibit distinct strengths and failure modes: First, regarding executability, all three coding agents achieve 100% TPR, consistently outperforming StubCoder , which achieves 74.6% when reproduced under its original generation-mode configuration (Table 8 ). However, standalone DeepSeek achieves only 61.0%, lagging behind StubCoder . This highlights that without runtime feedback, standalone LLMs struggle to ensure the syntactical and type validity of stub codes, falling behind type-guided, search-based tools like StubCoder that operate over statically resolved symbol spaces. Coding agent bridge this gap. Instead of guessing in a single pass, coding agents read the compiler errors and test failures, step-by-step correcting import and syntax mistakes until all suites execute successfully.

paragraphs.en: As for the stub quality, running without errors still does not guarantee that the generated stubs are correct. Following the protocol in Section 4.2 , we evaluate the fine-grained fidelity of the synthesized stub code across four dimensions (Table 8 ). Across these dimensions, both standalone DeepSeek and the three agents consistently outperform StubCoder . The widest gap appears in argument reconstruction: while standalone DeepSeek and the coding agents achieve F1 scores between 0.615 and 0.787, StubCoder manages only 0.126. This disparity stems from their underlying synthesis mechanisms. StubCoder relies on search-based techniques over a symbol pool mined strictly from local test contexts. While this localized pool suffices for identifying visible mock targets and method signatures, it cannot capture the interaction logic between the caller and its dependencies, failing to synthesize complex object states required by subsequent operations. In contrast, LLM-based approaches leverage vast BPE-based vocabularies to flexibly synthesize out-of-context objects and variables beyond a fixed local symbol pool.

sents.en: While this localized pool suffices for identifying visible mock targets and method signatures, it cannot capture the interaction logic between the caller and its dependencies, failing to synthesize complex object states required by subsequent operations.
sents.zh: 尽管这种局部化的符号池足以识别可见的模拟目标和方法签名，但它无法捕捉调用者与其依赖项之间的交互逻辑，因而无法合成后续操作所需的复杂对象状态。

sents.en: In contrast, LLM-based approaches leverage vast BPE-based vocabularies to flexibly synthesize out-of-context objects and variables beyond a fixed local symbol pool.
sents.zh: 相比之下，基于大语言模型的方法利用庞大的 BPE 词汇表，能够灵活地合成超出固定本地符号池范围的外部对象和变量。

paragraphs.en: Executability under different time budgets. Increasing the wall-clock budget substantially improves the executability of T C T^{C} across all three coding agents and both languages(Figure 1 ). At 60 s, the average TPR across the three agents is only 10.5% on Java and 5.5% on Python. When the budget is extended to 600 s, these values increase to 92.4% and 91.4%, respectively. The sharp improvement indicates that a short time budget frequently prevents agents from completing the generation–validation–repair workflow. In other words, a considerable fraction of execution failures under tight budgets stems from insufficient time to complete the task rather than from an inability to produce executable tests.

paragraphs.en: Resource cost of additional execution time. The higher executability is accompanied by greater agent activity and token consumption (Figure 1 ). For example, the average number of interaction rounds across the three agents increases from 7.5 at 60 s to 18.4 at 300 s on Java, and from 6.1 to 13.8 on Python. However, resource consumption does not grow proportionally with the wall-clock limit. From 300 s to 600 s, the increase in interaction rounds is much smaller, reaching 19.5 rounds on Java and 15.5 on Python. A similar pattern appears in token usage: some agents consume only moderately more tokens under 600 s, while mini-SWE-agent shows almost no additional consumption on Python and even a lower mean on Java. This is expected because the wall-clock budget is an upper bound: agents may terminate before exhausting the available time, and different execution trajectories can consume different amounts of computation. Behavioral fidelity under larger budgets. The additional computation, however, does not yield corresponding improvements in mock behavioral fidelity (Figure 1 ). At the main 300 s setting, the average agent coarse-grained F1 scores for mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions are 83.59%, 68.78%, and 62.39% on Java, respectively. At 600 s, these scores remain at 84.02%, 61.68%, and 58.73%. The same pattern appears on Python: the corresponding F1 scores change from 82.15%, 49.48%, and 44.57% at 300 s to 79.84%, 47.30%, and 44.05% at 600 s. Thus, although a larger budget allows substantially more candidates to execute successfully, the fidelity gaps identified in RQ2, particularly for stubs and mock assertions, persist. We do not interpret the comparatively high F1 scores at 60 s as evidence that shorter budgets produce better mocks, since only a very small, selective subset of candidates becomes executable within 60 s for fidelity evaluation.

paragraphs.en: This section invested approximately 120 person-hours in a systematic qualitative study following the thematic analysis guidelines by Cruzes and Dybå ( Cruzes and Dybå, 2011 ) . We analyzed 660 executable T C T^{C} s from a single evaluation run across standalone DeepSeek and three DeepSeek-powered coding agents. Recall the experimental results in RQ2: no single LLM or coding agent consistently surpasses others. Thus, we chose DeepSeek and used it as a backbone across agents in this RQ for its cost-effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 本节根据 Cruzes 和 Dybå（Cruzes 和 Dybå，2011）的主题分析指南，投入了约 120 人时进行了一项系统性的定性研究。 我们分析了来自单次评估运行中的 660 个可执行的 T C T^{C} s，涵盖独立的 DeepSeek 以及三种基于 DeepSeek 的编码智能体。 回顾 RQ2 中的实验结果：没有任何一种 LLM 或编码智能体能始终优于其他模型。 因此，我们选择了 DeepSeek，并因其成本效益，在本研究问题中将其用作各智能体的基础模型。

paragraphs.en: First, a domain expert with over six years of development experience in Python and Java analyzes a random 20% sample of the failure cases to identify and summarize the underlying causes. The expert iteratively grouped these observations into well-defined error categories, establishing clear taxonomy criteria and representative examples, which were formalized into a codebook. Next, we recruited four independent evaluators, all with computer science backgrounds and at least three years of professional or research experience in Python and Java. The evaluation followed a rigorous, double-blind, dual-review process: each sample was inspected independently by two evaluators without cross-communication. When both evaluators agreed on the classification, the result was finalized (Cohen’s Kappa κ = 0.794 \kappa=0.794 ). Disagreements were resolved through structured discussion; if a consensus could not be reached, the case was escalated to the domain expert for final arbitration.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，一位在 Python 和 Java 开发领域拥有超过六年经验的专业人士，对随机抽取的 20% 故障案例样本进行分析，以识别并总结其根本原因。 该专家通过迭代方式将这些观察结果归入明确界定的错误类别，确立了清晰的分类标准与代表性示例，并将其正式整理成一本编码手册。 接下来，我们招募了四位独立的评估员，他们均具备计算机科学背景，并在 Python 和 Java 领域拥有至少三年的专业或研究经验。 评估过程遵循严格的、双盲的、双重评审流程：每个样本由两位评估员独立检查，且彼此之间不得交流。 当两位评估员对分类结果达成一致时，该结果即被最终确定（科恩卡帕系数 κ = 0.794 \kappa=0.794）。 分歧通过结构化讨论解决；若无法达成共识，则将该案例提交给领域专家进行最终裁定。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 summarizes the failure types across executable candidate suites, revealing distinct error distributions between standalone LLMs and coding agents: (1) Standalone LLMs primarily suffer from stubbing errors (71.43% in Java and 68.75% in Python), as direct synthesis lacking execution feedback often yields incorrect stub behaviors or response values. (2) Coding agents fail predominantly from mock assertion errors (66.67% in Java and 81.54% in Python), with missing assertions alone exceeding 44% across languages. This explains our finding in RQ2 (Section 5.2 ): feedback-driven repair primarily optimizes for passing test execution, where agents often eliminate runtime failures by weakening or discarding strict interaction checks rather than fixing them. (3) Mock object errors are the least frequent (14.29%–37.04%), showing that identifying target dependencies is relatively straightforward compared to generating correct logic and verifications. We illustrate each type of error below.
paragraphs.zh: 表 9 总结了可执行候选套件中的故障类型，揭示了独立 LLM 和编码智能体之间不同的错误分布：(1) 独立 LLM 主要遭受占位符错误（Java 中占 71.43%，Python 中占 68.75%），因为缺乏执行反馈的直接合成常常导致不正确的占位符行为或响应值。 (2) 编码智能体的故障主要源于模拟断言错误（Java 中占 66.67%，Python 中占 81.54%），其中仅断言缺失的情况在所有语言中就超过了 44%。 这解释了我们在 RQ2（第 5.2 节）中的发现：基于反馈的修复主要优化测试执行通过率，智能体通常会通过弱化或丢弃严格的交互检查来消除运行时故障，而不是真正修复它们。 (3) 模拟对象错误是频率最低的（14.29%–37.04%），这表明与生成正确逻辑和验证相比，识别目标依赖关系相对简单。 我们在下文对每种类型的错误进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: Mock object errors(A). (1) Missing mocks(A-1): This error occurs when T C T^{C} completely omits a dependency mocked in T G T^{G} , breaking test isolation. As Figure 2 (a) shows, T C T^{C} mocks Option while omitting the dependency _param_memo mocked in T G T^{G} . As a result, the real _param_memo remains active during execution. This error turns the intended isolated unit test into an accidental integration test, making it fragile to underlying implementation changes. (2) Non-mock replacements(A-2): Here, models avoid mocking altogether by creating real, concrete objects instead of dynamic mocks. Figure 2 (b) shows this in the Apollo case: instead of mocking ApolloConfig to intercept getConfigurations() , the generator creates a real configuration object and calls setConfigurations(configurations) . This real object provides enough in-memory state to prevent runtime crashes, but it strips away the interaction semantics required by T G T^{G} .
paragraphs.zh: 模拟对象错误 (A)。 (1) 缺少模拟对象 (A-1)：当 T C T^{C} 完全省略了 T G T^{G} 中模拟的依赖项时，就会发生此错误，从而破坏了测试的隔离性。 如图 2 (a) 所示，T C T^{C} 模拟了 Option，但省略了 T G T^{G} 中模拟的依赖项 _param_memo。 因此，真实的 _param_memo 在执行期间仍然处于激活状态。 此错误将原本应隔离的单元测试变成了意外的集成测试，使其对底层实现的变化变得脆弱。 (2) 非模拟替换 (A-2)：在此情况下，模型完全避免使用模拟对象，转而创建真实的、具体的对象，而不是动态模拟对象。 图 2 (b) 展示了 Apollo 案例中的这种情况：生成器没有通过模拟 ApolloConfig 来拦截 getConfigurations()，而是创建了一个真实的配置对象，并调用了 setConfigurations(configurations)。 这个真实对象提供了足够的内存状态以防止运行时崩溃，但它剥离了 T G T^{G} 所要求的交互语义。

sents.en: (1) Missing mocks(A-1): This error occurs when T C T^{C} completely omits a dependency mocked in T G T^{G} , breaking test isolation.
sents.zh: (1) 缺少模拟对象 (A-1)：当 T C T^{C} 完全省略了 T G T^{G} 中模拟的依赖项时，就会发生此错误，从而破坏了测试的隔离性。

sents.en: As Figure 2 (a) shows, T C T^{C} mocks Option while omitting the dependency _param_memo mocked in T G T^{G} .
sents.zh: 如图 2 (a) 所示，T C T^{C} 模拟了 Option，但省略了 T G T^{G} 中模拟的依赖项 _param_memo。

sents.en: As a result, the real _param_memo remains active during execution.
sents.zh: 因此，真实的 _param_memo 在执行期间仍然处于激活状态。

sents.en: This error turns the intended isolated unit test into an accidental integration test, making it fragile to underlying implementation changes.
sents.zh: 此错误将原本应隔离的单元测试变成了意外的集成测试，使其对底层实现的变化变得脆弱。

sents.en: (2) Non-mock replacements(A-2): Here, models avoid mocking altogether by creating real, concrete objects instead of dynamic mocks.
sents.zh: (2) 非模拟替换 (A-2)：在此情况下，模型完全避免使用模拟对象，转而创建真实的、具体的对象，而不是动态模拟对象。

sents.en: Figure 2 (b) shows this in the Apollo case: instead of mocking ApolloConfig to intercept getConfigurations() , the generator creates a real configuration object and calls setConfigurations(configurations) .
sents.zh: 图 2 (b) 展示了 Apollo 案例中的这种情况：生成器没有通过模拟 ApolloConfig 来拦截 getConfigurations()，而是创建了一个真实的配置对象，并调用了 setConfigurations(configurations)。

sents.en: This real object provides enough in-memory state to prevent runtime crashes, but it strips away the interaction semantics required by T G T^{G} .
sents.zh: 这个真实对象提供了足够的内存状态以防止运行时崩溃，但它剥离了 T G T^{G} 所要求的交互语义。

paragraphs.en: Stubbing errors(B). (1) Missing stubs(B-1): A mock is retained, but one of its reference-specified stubs is omitted. As shown in Figure 3 (a), while the reference test configures responses for getInterface , invoke , and invoker.getUrl() , the agent preserves the former two but drops getUrl() . (2)Argument-matching errors(B-2): Multiple responses conditioned on distinct input parameters collapse into a single catch-all stub. In Apollo’s reference gray-release test, the stub returns false for arbitrary string inputs but true for a specific argument combination. The agent collapses this conditional logic into a broadly matched true response (Figure 3 (b)). (3) Stub behavior errors(B-3): A response is configured for the intended call, but its content diverges from the reference values. In Tqsdk, the reference test configures the mocked ma to return a scenario-derived series ( ma_result ) containing specific numeric values and NaNs across two invocations. Instead of reproducing these realistic values, the agent supplies a trivial all-ones series via side_effect (Figure 3 (c)).

paragraphs.en: Mock assertion errors(C). (1) Missing mock assertions(C-1): An interaction verified in T G T^{G} is omitted entirely from T C T^{C} . For example, in Hadoop’s testJobToString , the agent completely drops the verification for intermediate dependency calls, including getJobStatus , getTaskReports , and getTaskCompletionEvents (Figure 4 (a)). Consequently, although oracle assertions verify the final result, the critical dependency interactions enforced by T G T^{G} remain unverified. (2) Call-matching errors(C-2): The interaction check is retained, but the constraints on its call arguments are weakened. Specifically, in Flask(Figure 4 (b)), the standalone candidate uses assert_called_once() for response_class , preserving the reference call-count constraint while omitting the requirement that the call take no arguments. (3) Call-count verification errors(C-3): A check on call arguments is preserved, but the required invocation frequency is unenforced. In Langflow, the candidate correctly inspects the arguments of the most recent invocation against the reference, but drops the assertion enforcing that it was invoked exactly once (Figure 4 (c)). Validating the latest payload thus fails to guarantee that spurious intermediate calls did not occur. (4) Call-order verification errors(C-4): Individual invocations remain verified, but their execution sequence is disregarded. While the Crawl4AI reference verifies the exact sequential execution of all actions against expected_commands , the agent instead checks the two calls independently using unordered assert_any_call assertions (Figure 4 (d)). Although this preserves call presence and multiplicity, it leaves the temporal order of side effects unchecked. (5) Missing await verification(C-5): An asynchronous interaction requirement is degraded into a synchronous invocation check. In Tqsdk, the candidate substitutes the reference await assertion with a standard assert_called_once_with (Figure 4 (e)). Even though the payload and call count are verified, this substitution fails to ensure that the coroutine was actually scheduled and awaited before test completion.

paragraphs.en: Implications for researchers: (1) As the first systematic study on mock artifact generation, this work reveals a fundamental pitfall: LLMs and coding agents synthesize mocks merely to satisfy tests, so test execution status alone is a misleading quality signal and should not serve as the sole benchmark for assessment ( Barr et al., 2015 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . (2) By jointly measuring executability, behavioral fidelity, and interaction-fault detection, we expose behavioral deviations and silent losses in fault detection that passing tests conceal, and offer ready-to-use evaluation criteria for future research. (3) Scaling repair rounds and time budgets substantially boosts executability, yet yields no commensurate gain in behavioral fidelity, evidencing that coding agents optimize for crash avoidance rather than semantic correctness. This implies that future techniques should embed interaction contracts directly into generation objectives ( Barr et al., 2015 ; Freeman et al., 2004 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . (4) Our failure analysis distills 660 failures into ten error types spanning mock objects, stubs, and assertions, all of which survive behind passing tests; this taxonomy converts previously invisible failure modes into explicit optimization targets for faithfully reconstructing mock behaviors and enforcing interaction checks.
paragraphs.zh: 对研究者的启示：(1) 作为关于模拟对象生成的首个系统性研究，这项工作揭示了一个根本性陷阱：大型语言模型和编码智能体生成模拟对象仅仅是为了通过测试，因此仅凭测试执行状态会误导质量判断，不应将其作为评估的唯一基准（Barr 等，2015；Zhu 等，2025）。 (2) 通过联合衡量可执行性、行为保真度和交互故障检测能力，我们暴露了故障检测中被通过测试所掩盖的行为偏差和隐性损失，并为未来研究提供了可直接使用的评估标准。 (3) 增加修复轮次和时间预算能显著提升可执行性，但并未带来相应程度的行为保真度提升，这表明编码智能体更倾向于优化避免崩溃，而非语义正确性。 这意味着未来的技术应将交互契约直接嵌入生成目标中（Barr 等，2015；Freeman 等，2004；Zhu 等，2025）。 (4) 我们的故障分析将 660 个故障归因于十种错误类型，涵盖模拟对象、占位程序和断言，这些错误在通过测试的情况下仍然存在；这一分类体系将此前不可见的故障模式转化为明确的优化目标，以忠实地重建模拟行为并强制执行交互检查。

paragraphs.en: Implications for practitioners: (1) We construct MockBench, the first benchmark for mock quality evaluation, comprising 165 validated mock-related samples from real-world Java and Python projects that can be directly adopted for industrial evaluation. (2) Our experiments across six LLMs and three coding agents reveal their heterogeneous strengths: agents excel at executability, but such gains do not translate into behavioral fidelity or fault detection, providing evidence-based guidance for technique selection in mock-based testing. (3) The sensitivity analysis shows that enlarging agent time budgets improves executability only within a limited range and never behavioral fidelity. Practitioners should therefore treat passing tests as a necessary but insufficient checkpoint, invest in explicit behavioral verification rather than additional repair rounds, and consult our ten-type failure taxonomy to inspect the risks that remain concealed when generated tests pass ( Freeman et al., 2004 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对从业者的启示：(1) 我们构建了 MockBench，这是首个用于模拟质量评估的基准测试，包含 165 个经过验证的与模拟相关的样本，这些样本来自真实的 Java 和 Python 项目，可直接用于工业评估。 (2) 我们在六种大型语言模型和三种编码智能体上进行的实验揭示了它们各自不同的优势：智能体在执行性方面表现突出，但这种优势并未转化为行为保真度或故障检测能力的提升，这为基于模拟的测试中的技术选择提供了基于证据的指导。 (3) 敏感性分析表明，增加智能体的时间预算只能在有限范围内提升执行性，而绝不会提升行为保真度。 因此，从业者应将测试通过视为必要但不足的检查点，应投资于明确的行为验证而非额外的修复轮次，并参考我们提出的十类失败分类法，以检查生成测试通过时仍可能隐藏的风险（Freeman et al., 2004；Zhu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Threats to external validity. Our evaluation is limited to mock artifact generation in Java and Python, excluding other PLs. However, given that Java and Python represent both statically- and dynamically-typed PLs, carry mature mocking ecosystems, and are widely used in practical development, the threat is minimal. Second, our findings may not generalize across all LLMs and agent architectures. These threats are also limited, as we tested diverse LLMs and coding agents of commercial, general, and code, as well as closed/open-source. Thus, experimental subjects are representative. paragraphs.en: Threats to internal validity. To prevent data leakage, MockBench features newly authored Python tests alongside Java tests augmented with additional mock artifacts. To reduce errors in manual construction, a lead reviewer examined all reference suites for dependency selection, scenario design, and mock-artifact completeness, followed by execution validation. Towards the subjectivity of failure analysis, each sample was independently inspected by two evaluators using a shared codebook developed through thematic analysis ( Cruzes and Dybå, 2011 ) , with disagreements resolved through discussion and expert adjudication. Hence, the above threats are minimal.
paragraphs.zh: 对内部效度的威胁。 为防止数据泄露，MockBench 采用了新编写的 Python 测试用例，以及通过添加额外模拟工件而增强的 Java 测试用例。 为减少手动构建中的错误，一位主要评审员检查了所有参考套件，评估了依赖项的选择、场景设计以及模拟工件的完整性，随后进行了执行验证。 针对故障分析的主观性问题，两名评估员使用通过主题分析（Cruzes and Dybå, 2011）制定的共享代码手册对每个样本进行了独立检查，并通过讨论和专家裁决解决了分歧。 因此，上述威胁的影响微乎其微。

paragraphs.en: This work presents MockBench, a bilingual benchmark for evaluating the generation of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions. Through extensive experiments on six LLMs and three coding agents, we examine their capabilities in terms of executability, behavioral fidelity, and fault detection. The results show that coding agents significantly improve test executability, while passing tests may mask behavioral deviations and losses in interaction fault detection capability. Increasing the agents’ time budget can improve executability within an effective range, but incurs higher resource costs without a corresponding improvement in behavioral fidelity. Finally, our systematic failure analysis identifies ten error types across three categories of mock artifacts, providing concrete directions for future research and practical guidance for reviewing generated mock artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究提出了 MockBench，一个用于评估模拟对象、模拟桩和模拟断言生成的双语基准。 通过在六个大型语言模型和三个编码智能体上进行广泛实验，我们检验了它们在可执行性、行为保真度和故障检测方面的能力。 结果表明，编码智能体能显著提升测试的可执行性，但通过测试可能会掩盖行为偏差，并导致交互故障检测能力的下降。 增加智能体的时间预算可以在有效范围内提升可执行性，但会引发更高的资源成本，而行为保真度并未相应改善。 最后，我们的系统性故障分析识别出模拟工件三大类别中的十种错误类型，为未来研究提供了具体方向，并为审查生成的模拟工件提供了实用指导。
